name: repair-tickets
description: Chromebook/device repair ticket management with Google Workspace lookups and status emails

scripts.docker:build: GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml build
scripts.docker:up: npm run docker:build && docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
